headline: Nigeria Ports Authority Accused of Stalling Exports With Manual Approvals
summary: Nigeria's non-oil exporters have accused the Nigerian Ports Authority of stalling export activities by replacing an automated system with manual approvals.
why: Inefficiencies at major port authorities increase logistics costs and delay trade flows in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Manual export approvals at ports create operational friction for non-oil exporters in the country.
